    AI Overview
    To watch the New York Mets vs. St. Louis Cardinals, tune in to
    SNY (Mets regional network) or Cardinals.TV (via MLB App) for regional coverage on April 1, 2026, at 1:15 p.m. ET. Streaming options include Fubo (free trial available) and MLB.TV for out-of-market viewers. 
    TV Channels & Streaming Services 
    • Regional TV (NY): SNY (SportsNet New York).
    • Regional TV (St. Louis): Cardinals.TV (available on cable/satellite, such as Spectrum channels 362 or 233).
    • Streaming In-Market: Cardinals.TV via MLB App or Fubo.
    • Streaming Out-of-Market: MLB.TV. 
    Game Details 
    • Date: Wednesday, April 1, 2026
    • Time: 1:15 p.m. ET (12:15 p.m. CT)
    • Location: Busch Stadium, St. Louis 
    Note: For the 2026 season, local Cardinals games are produced by MLB under the name Cardinals.TV, replacing FanDuel Sports Network Midwest.
